assets.title: App Store pad screenshot (storefront set us:pad5)

quality.notes: Apple's PNG rendition of the PNG upload at native size (lossless; requested instead of the lossy variant the page or API advertises). A store re-render, not the untouched upload file. Apple writes a per-response identifier into the renditions it serves (a 26-character token in EXIF UserComment, and in XMP dc:creator for PNG), so a re-fetch of the same URL can return different bytes and SHA-256 with identical pixels: re-verify App Store items by decoded pixels, not by hash.
